name: n8n
description: Panel-only extension that surfaces the local N8N workflow editor (port 5678) inside the Wylde Tauri shell. The N8N daemon itself runs as a Wylde service under <wylde_root>/N8N/ — this extension just declares its UI panel so the GUI's Tools tab can mount it.
command: import sys; sys.stderr.write('n8n is panel-only; this extension has no MCP server yet — declare tools when the n8n MCP bridge ships\n')
